scope_note: Inventory only: what exists and what it is proven to do. No ranking, no combinations, no external research, no promise assessment.

database.method: row count, key columns, writer file(s), reader file(s), scheduled-vs-one-off character, last-write freshness where a timestamp column exists

sweep_scope.grouping_method_note: 43 one-off metric_v2/layer0 pre-registration/findings/amendment tables are grouped into 2 summary asset records (data_d9, data_d10) rather than 43 individual records, because the DB audit found they share one pattern: written solely by their own generating script, no programmatic reader, by design (one-time output-of-record). This is explicitly distinct from the elo_snapshots pattern. See full_table_list on those records.

assets.name: geo_elo / geo_elo_active
assets.location: first-repo, _compute_geo_elo and related trade-evaluation code; still written live daily via scripts/update_geo_elo.py, a scheduled daily_maintenance.py step
assets.what_it_claims_to_do: Rate a trader's geopolitical-market skill via an ELO-style scoring system, feeding the LEGENDARY tier ladder.
assets.defect: 5 independently confirmed defects: (1) SIGN ERROR - expected=1.0-price but price already equals P(traded outcome wins) for both sides, confirmed empirically (paired Yes/No trades within 60s sum to 1.000+/-0.001); No-side trades scored against the wrong probability, and the module's own docstring embeds the same error. (2) IMPROPER SCORING RULE - zero-skill trader buying favoured No positions earns expected 2*price-1>0 per trade; ~71% of markets resolve No, volume clusters on favourites; LEGENDARY may have selected for favourite-betting No traders rather than skill. (3) SELL CONTAMINATION - 35.7% of qualifying population (88,927 rows) folded in under trade_evaluator.py's inverted win-condition, no side filter in _fetch_qualifying_trades. (4) DOUBLE-COUNTING - 52.3% of (trader,market) pairs have >1 qualifying trade (86.3% of all qualifying trades, median 2, max 642) - K-schedule counted decision fragments not decisions. (5) UNCALIBRATED PARAMETERS - K-schedule 32/24/16, start 1500, ratchet 150/step, MIN_TRADES=5, decay half-life 180d, tier ladder 1000/1400/1800/2175 all have no calibration record; 2175/1800 copied from discredited comprehensive_elo; 1000/1400 claim of being lifted exactly from source scripts verified inaccurate.
assets.explicitly_not_one_bug: Sign error alone is NOT the dominant driver of rank disagreement (corr=0.088 position-weighted, 0.112 cap5) - several independently broken mechanisms, hence full rebuild not a patch.
assets.status: CONDEMNED but still operationally live - update_geo_elo.py continues to run daily as of 2026-09-12 (confirmed this session's own start-of-session check).
